# LocalEditor

> LocalEditor is a private image studio plus 31 browser tools for images, PDFs, text, and everyday tasks. Editing runs on the device. Files are not uploaded, no account is required, and the site can be installed for offline use.

Key facts:
- Price: free, unlimited, no watermarks, no sign-up.
- Privacy: all processing happens on the user's device; no server receives files.
- Offline: a service worker caches every tool after the first visit.
- Install: Android/desktop via "Install app"; iOS via Safari Share → Add to Home Screen.

## Image tools

- [Image Compressor](https://localeditor.net/image-compressor/): Shrink JPG, PNG & WebP file size without visible quality loss.
- [Image Resizer](https://localeditor.net/image-resizer/): Resize photos to exact pixels, percent or social presets.
- [Image Converter](https://localeditor.net/image-converter/): Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP in bulk.
- [Image Cropper](https://localeditor.net/image-cropper/): Crop to any size or aspect ratio like 1:1 or 16:9.
- [Rotate & Flip Image](https://localeditor.net/rotate-flip-image/): Rotate by any angle and mirror horizontally or vertically.
- [Watermark Image](https://localeditor.net/watermark-image/): Stamp text or a logo on photos — single or tiled.
- [Image to Base64](https://localeditor.net/image-to-base64/): Turn images into data URLs and back again.
- [Image Color Picker](https://localeditor.net/color-picker/): Pick exact colors and extract palettes from any image.
- [Favicon Generator](https://localeditor.net/favicon-generator/): Create favicon.ico and app icons from an image or emoji.
- [Photo Filters & Editor](https://localeditor.net/image-filters/): Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and apply filters.
- [Photo Privacy Check](https://localeditor.net/photo-privacy/): See and remove hidden location, time and camera details in a photo.

## PDF tools

- [Merge PDF](https://localeditor.net/merge-pdf/): Combine multiple PDFs into one in the order you choose.
- [Split PDF](https://localeditor.net/split-pdf/): Extract page ranges or split every page into its own file.
- [JPG to PDF](https://localeditor.net/jpg-to-pdf/): Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images into a single PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://localeditor.net/pdf-to-jpg/): Turn every PDF page into a high-quality JPG or PNG.
- [Rotate PDF](https://localeditor.net/rotate-pdf/): Rotate one page or all pages and save permanently.
- [Organize PDF](https://localeditor.net/organize-pdf/): Reorder, delete, duplicate and insert PDF pages.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://localeditor.net/add-page-numbers/): Number PDF pages with custom position and format.
- [Watermark PDF](https://localeditor.net/watermark-pdf/): Add a text watermark such as CONFIDENTIAL to every page.

## Text tools

- [Word Counter](https://localeditor.net/word-counter/): Count words, characters, sentences and reading time.
- [Case Converter](https://localeditor.net/case-converter/): UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, snake_case and more.
- [Text Compare (Diff)](https://localeditor.net/text-diff/): Highlight differences between two texts line by line.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://localeditor.net/lorem-ipsum-generator/): Generate placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words.

## Developer & everyday utilities

- [QR Code Generator](https://localeditor.net/qr-code-generator/): Make QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi, contacts — PNG & SVG.
- [Password Generator](https://localeditor.net/password-generator/): Create strong random passwords and passphrases.
- [JSON Formatter](https://localeditor.net/json-formatter/): Beautify, minify and validate JSON with error hints.
- [Base64 Encode / Decode](https://localeditor.net/base64-encoder/): Encode and decode Base64 text and files with UTF-8.
- [Hash Generator](https://localeditor.net/hash-generator/): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 for text and files.
- [Unit Converter](https://localeditor.net/unit-converter/): Length, weight, temperature, data and 6 more categories.
- [Color Converter](https://localeditor.net/color-converter/): HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK conversion with contrast checker.
- [UUID Generator](https://localeditor.net/uuid-generator/): Bulk-generate UUID v4 and v7 and validate UUIDs.

- [PDF and documents](https://localeditor.net/pdf/): Sign, fill, merge and convert PDFs.
- [Privacy tools](https://localeditor.net/privacy-tools/): Hidden photo data, storage and offline use.
- [Social and creators](https://localeditor.net/social/): Posts, stories and collages for every platform.

## Features

- [Collage maker](https://localeditor.net/collage-maker/): Layouts and styles with a slot for every photo.
- [Photo backgrounds](https://localeditor.net/photo-backgrounds/): Crop, blur and dim a photo behind your design.
- [Recipes and batch editing](https://localeditor.net/batch-edit/): One look, applied to many photos.
- [Sizes for every platform](https://localeditor.net/social-media-sizes/): Instagram, story, YouTube and more, ready to go.
- [Photo editor](https://localeditor.net/photo-editor/): Crop, light, colour and filters.
- [Text and fonts](https://localeditor.net/add-text-to-photo/): Titles and captions in dozens of typefaces.
- [Brand kit](https://localeditor.net/brand-kit/): Your colours, fonts and logos in every design.
- [PDF studio](https://localeditor.net/pdf-editor/): Sign, fill, annotate and reorder pages.
- [Convert to PDF](https://localeditor.net/word-to-pdf/): Office files, images and text into PDFs.
- [Install and offline use](https://localeditor.net/install/): Home screen app that works offline.
- [Storage manager](https://localeditor.net/storage-manager/): What the app keeps here, and a clear button.
